mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely related to S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, with higher rates predicting negative returns due to compressed equity discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 2.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 6.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to monetary policy tightening expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 6.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5% and year-over-year CPI change (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 5.0%, it signals a tight labor market and persistent inflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500, it signals economic weakness that triggers positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated Federal Reserve rate cuts.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST falls below 1500, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals an economic contraction that causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to recession fears.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 and housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500, it signals a dual economic contraction that causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS above 3.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY change above 3.0%), S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 60 trading days due to sustained high interest rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances during the defined regime, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.0%, it signals labor market weakness that triggers positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to anticipated Federal Reserve rate cuts.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE rises above 4.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
